title: Beyond Coherence: Benchmarking Professional Editing-Technique Execution in Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08275v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent multi-shot audio-video generators can produce increasingly coherent and cinematic outputs, but coherence does not imply the ability to execute editing techniques. Professional editing depends on shot structure, transition grammar, audio-video cut relations, and montage, yet existing benchmarks largely rely on proxies such as content quality, synchronization, or physical plausibility, systematically missing whether such editing instructions are actually executed. We introduce CutCraft, the first benchmark for editing-technique execution in multi-shot audio-video generation. CutCraft extends structured multi-shot prompts with explicit editing specifications and is paired with a hierarchical hybrid evaluation framework that combines shot-structure alignment, expert-model metrics, tool-grounded multimodal judgment, and rubric-based question answering. Beyond evaluation, we design an agentic editing baseline that decomposes generation

translated_title: 超越连贯性：多镜头音视频生成中专业剪辑技术执行的基准测试
translated_abstract: 近期的多镜头音视频生成器能够产出日益连贯且具电影感的输出，但连贯性并不意味着具备执行剪辑技术的能力。专业剪辑依赖于镜头结构、转场语法、音视频剪辑关系以及蒙太奇，然而现有基准大多依赖内容质量、同步性或物理合理性等替代指标，系统性地遗漏了此类剪辑指令是否被真正执行的问题。我们提出了 CutCraft，这是首个面向多镜头音视频生成中剪辑技术执行的基准。CutCraft 在结构化多镜头提示词的基础上扩展了显式的剪辑规格说明，并配备了一个分层混合评估框架，该框架结合了镜头结构对齐、专家模型指标、基于工具的多模态判断以及基于评分标准的问题回答。除评估之外，我们还设计了一个智能体式剪辑基线，它将生成过程分解为……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了首个针对多镜头音视频生成中专业剪辑技术执行能力的基准 CutCraft，通过显式剪辑规格说明与分层混合评估框架，填补了现有基准只衡量连贯性而忽视剪辑指令是否真正被执行的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CutCraft, the first benchmark for evaluating professional editing-technique execution in multi-shot audio-video generation, which combines explicit editing specifications with a hierarchical hybrid evaluation framework to assess whether editing instructions are actually executed, beyond mere coherence.
